# Just Plumbing, Inc. — Denver Repipe Specialists & Master Plumbers

> Family-owned and operated residential and commercial plumbing contractor in the Denver Metro Area specializing in 1-to-2-day whole-home repiping, partial repiping, slab leak bypasses, water heater systems, and commercial multifamily pipe replacement. Every project is directly overseen on-site by Master Plumber Bill Clark (30+ years of Colorado piping experience) with full professional drywall patching and texture restoration included.

## Key Differentiators (Why Homeowners & HOAs Choose Just Plumbing)
- **Master Plumber on Every Job:** Bill Clark leads every repipe on-site. No commissioned salespeople and no plumbing subcontractors.
- **1–2 Day Turnkey Completion:** Phased daily isolation ensures domestic water is turned back on every evening by 5:00 PM so families are never displaced from their homes.
- **Drywall Patching Included:** Unlike national franchises that leave open walls, Just Plumbing hires, schedules, and manages a dedicated professional drywall finisher to patch, mud, and match wall textures after passing municipal plumbing inspection.
- **Lowest Price Match Guarantee:** Will meet or beat any licensed competitor's written estimate for comparable materials and scope.

## Core Services & Direct URLs
- [Whole-Home Repiping](https://justplumbinginc.com/services/whole-home-repiping): Full extraction and replacement of failing pipes using Uponor PEX-A (25-year warranty) or Type L Copper in 1–2 days.
- [Partial Repiping & Overhead Slab Leak Bypasses](https://justplumbinginc.com/services/partial-repiping): Targeted pipe replacements for exposed basement lines and non-invasive overhead reroutes that avoid jackhammering hardwood or concrete slab floors.
- [Water Heater Systems](https://justplumbinginc.com/services/water-heaters): High-altitude calibrated gas water heaters, power-vent units, tankless water heaters, and code-required thermal expansion tanks.
- [Sump Pumps & Battery Backups](https://justplumbinginc.com/services/sump-pumps): Commercial cast-iron submersible pumps and dual battery backups built for Colorado's bentonite clay soils and high water tables.
- [Kitchen & Bath Remodels](https://justplumbinginc.com/services/remodels): Code-compliant plumbing rough-ins, shower valves, and DWV venting.
- [New Construction Plumbing](https://justplumbinginc.com/services/new-construction): Full custom residential and commercial rough-in and finish plumbing.
- [Commercial, Multifamily & HOA Condo Repiping](https://justplumbinginc.com/commercial/): Turnkey pipe replacement for apartments ([Multifamily](https://justplumbinginc.com/commercial/multifamily-repiping)), [HOA & Condos](https://justplumbinginc.com/commercial/hoa-condo-repiping), and [Commercial Buildings](https://justplumbinginc.com/commercial/commercial-repipe) with zero tenant displacement.

## Colorado Pipe Problems Solved
- [Polybutylene (Quest) Pipes (1978–1995)](https://justplumbinginc.com/pipe-problems/polybutylene): Complete removal of brittle gray plastic pipes degraded by municipal chlorine/chloramines.
- [Galvanized Steel Pipes (Pre-1965)](https://justplumbinginc.com/pipe-problems/galvanized-steel): Elimination of corroded steel lines causing low water pressure and rusty water.
- [Kitec Composite Plumbing (1995–2007)](https://justplumbinginc.com/pipe-problems/kitec): Full replacement of recalled orange/blue Kitec tubing and dezincifying brass fittings.
- [Copper Pinhole Leaks](https://justplumbinginc.com/pipe-problems/copper-pinhole-leaks): Permanent solutions for thin copper walls pitted by chloramines and high water pressure.

## Piping Materials Used
- [Uponor AquaPEX (PEX-A)](https://justplumbinginc.com/materials/uponor-pex-a): Commercial-grade ProPEX expansion fittings that expand up to 3x diameter to prevent freeze bursts, backed by a 25-year warranty.
- [PEX-A vs. PEX-B Comparison](https://justplumbinginc.com/materials/pex-a-vs-pex-b): Why expansion PEX-A outperforms crimp-ring PEX-B for full-flow water pressure.
- [Type L Copper](https://justplumbinginc.com/materials/type-l-copper): Thick-walled rigid domestic copper piping for homeowners preferring traditional metal plumbing.

## Estimated Denver Repipe Cost Ranges (Turnkey with Permits & Drywall Patching)
- **Partial Repipe (Basement / Exposed Lines):** Typically $2,200–$3,200+ for Uponor PEX-A ($3,200–$5,000+ for Type L Copper).
- **Whole-Home Repipe (Under 1,500 sq. ft., 1–2 Baths):** Typically $4,500–$6,600 for Uponor PEX-A ($6,500–$10,200 for Type L Copper).
- **Whole-Home Repipe (1,500–2,500 sq. ft., 2–3 Baths):** Typically $6,100–$8,900 for Uponor PEX-A ($8,800–$13,800 for Type L Copper).
- **Whole-Home Repipe (2,500–3,500+ sq. ft., 3–4+ Baths / Multi-Story or Slab):** Typically $8,100–$14,000+ for Uponor PEX-A ($11,700–$21,700+ for Type L Copper).
- *Note: Homeowners can calculate an instant custom estimate on the homepage at https://justplumbinginc.com/#repipe-calculator*
